items.title: Australians don't understand how interest rates work, RBA finds
items.description: The Reserve Bank is concerned that too many Australians have little idea what the central bank is trying to achieve with interest rates, which it says could be making its job harder.

items.title: Hanson labels domestic violence 'two-way street'
items.description: The One Nation leader said women should not 'put up with' domestic violence, as she highlighted the cost of living pressures on families.

items.title: 'These things didn’t happen': Senior Catholic cleric denies sex abuse
items.description: The lawyer for a former Catholic bishop who allegedly sexually abused three young men tells his trial the incidents did not happen, and warns the jury not to be affected by possible prejudice against the church.

items.title: Minister says Australian IS-linked 'Doctor Jihad' can 'rot' in Iraqi jail
items.description: Perth paediatrician Tareq Kamleh went to Syria to join the Islamic State group in 2015 and has, until now, been presumed dead.

items.title: 25,000-year-old grass-burning ritual unearthed in Victorian cave
items.description: Evidence of ancient burnt grasses unearthed in a Victorian cave suggest the old ancestors of the GunaiKurnai people used the cave for fire rituals during the Ice Age.

items.title: 'It has tested me': Rebel Wilson responds to defamation case win
items.description: Hollywood actor Rebel Wilson successfully defends a defamation case brought against her by the star of her directorial debut.

items.title: Why the Houthi threat against Saudi ships 'spells real trouble' for the war
items.description: The Houthi rebels, described as one of Iran's "merchants of chaos", have threatened to widen the conflict in the Middle East by declaring a maritime blockade on Saudi Arabia. Here's what could happen next.

items.title: Lewis breaks Australian 100m record, beats five-time Olympic champ
items.description: Torrie Lewis shows she is hitting her straps ahead of the Commonwealth Games by beating her own record mark during a meet in Slovakia.

items.title: Origin Energy investigating 'potential' customer data breach
items.description: Origin Energy says it does not believe customer credit card or bank details have been affected by a suspected data breach at the company.

items.title: Former Socceroos captain Paul Wade reveals probable CTE diagnosis
items.description: Paul Wade says he wants to share his experience to raise awareness about concussion, repeated head impacts and brain health across all levels of football.

items.title: President Trump Announces U.S. Military Airstrike in Venezuela
items.description: President Trump states the U.S. military conducted its first known airstrike inside Venezuela targeting a dock where drugs were allegedly loaded onto boats[1][2][4].

items.title: Trump Meets Netanyahu at Mar-a-Lago for Gaza Ceasefire Phase Two Talks
items.description: President Trump met with Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu to discuss advancing phase two of the Gaza ceasefire, including reconstruction and responses to Iran[1][4].

items.title: Feds Launch Massive Taxpayer Fraud Probe in Minnesota After Viral Video
items.description: Federal agencies including DHS, FBI, and ICE investigate $110 million in suspected fraud at Minnesota child care centers following a viral YouTube video[3].

items.title: Americans Express Widespread Opposition to AI Data Centers
items.description: Public backlash against AI infrastructure data centers grows, with protests and demands for bans influencing Democratic Party strategies for future elections[3].

items.title: Elon Musk's Humanoid Robot Vision: China Poised to Lead Production
items.description: China prioritizes humanoid robots in tech race with U.S., ramping up production while warning of industry bubble and potential bottlenecks[3].

items.title: Trump-Putin Call Amid Ukraine-Russia Tensions Over Peace Plan
items.description: President Trump spoke with Putin amid ongoing Ukraine conflict, with Russia reevaluating peace plan tenets after Ukrainian denials[1].

items.title: Democratic Gubernatorial Candidates in Wisconsin Focus on Inflation and Trump
items.description: Seven Democrats vying for Wisconsin governor blame economic issues on Trump and emphasize affordability ahead of 2026 primary[3].
